description: Enjoy a convenient viewing experience with this compact Yellow and White LED Projector, designed for home entertainment, movies, presentations and everyday multimedia use. Its compact design makes it easy to place on a table or carry between rooms. The projector comes with useful accessories including a remote control, power adapter, HDMI cable and AV connection cable, providing convenient connectivity with compatible devices. Its simple design and lightweight form make it suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, study areas, small presentations and entertainment setups.
